hero.title: Axopar 38 Cross Top
hero.heading: Axopar 38 Cross Top
hero.intro:
Some of the best days on the water begin before summer arrives, while others continue long after the forecast suggests heading home. The Axopar 38 Cross Top gives you the freedom to go when you want, stay as long as you like, and enjoy the journey in comfort. Not an open boat that asks you to compromise on protection. Not an enclosed boat that separates you from the sea.

The distinctive wraparound windshield creates a sheltered space where the horizon remains clear, and the journey feels effortless, even when the weather is less than perfect. Behind the helm, the boat opens up again. Friends gather, conversations flow, and the water remains as close as ever.

Just more of what makes boating enjoyable, on more days of the year.

sections.title: A Unique Balance Between Openness and Protection
sections.intro:
Why choose between open-air freedom and all-weather confidence when you can have both? The 38 Cross Top pairs a protected helm with an open, social cockpit, creating a boat that feels equally at home chasing horizons, slipping into hidden coves or stretching the day well beyond the original plan.

Up front, the distinctive wraparound windshield keeps wind, spray and glare in check, delivering comfort and visibility when conditions become more adventurous. Aft, the open cockpit keeps you connected to the sea, the sun and the company on board, with plenty of space for conversation, laughter and spontaneous swims.

sections.title: Your Day Your Way
sections.intro:
No two days on the water are alike, and the Axopar 38 Cross Top is designed to adapt. The highly modular cockpit transforms easily from a forward-facing cruising setup into a relaxed social lounge, dining area, or sunbed configuration.

The optional U-Sofa, with adjustable backrests, flexible seating, and a versatile hi-lo table, allows the space to evolve naturally throughout the day. Morning cruising, afternoon swimming, or evening dining all take place in one intelligent and flexible environment that suits your lifestyle.

sections.title: Pure Control
sections.intro:
The Axopar 38 is designed to feel intuitive from the moment you take the helm. Precise steering, exceptional tracking, a low center of gravity, and a perfectly balanced hull work together to create a driving experience that feels natural and predictable in all conditions. The boat responds exactly as you expect, requiring minimal correction while delivering confidence, comfort and control at every speed.

From first-time boaters to seasoned captains, everyone appreciates how effortlessly the Axopar 38 handles. Responsive enough to excite, yet forgiving enough to inspire confidence, it simply does what you ask it to do.

sections.title: Welcome to the Hull of Fame
sections.intro:
Every Axopar begins where the boating experience truly begins: below the waterline. Many boaters have learned to accept certain compromises as normal. Our hull-first approach gets the fundamentals right from the start. Since the first Axopar 28 was launched in 2014, this philosophy has shaped our multi-award-winning range, helped create the adventure boating category, and contributed to more than 7,600 Axopar boats being sold worldwide.

Discover the Hull of Fame and the engineering behind the distinctive Axopar driving experience.

sections.title: Aft Deck Alternatives & Configurations
sections.intro: We want to provide you with an extensively customizable, user-friendly boat that meets your everyday needs year-round and supports all your adventures. The configuration you choose will define the final layout of your boat. Below are a few examples of exterior layouts available.

items.title: Open Aft (Standard)
items.text: With standard 3+4 Sports Seats with Fixed Table & standard Fore Deck layout.

items.title: Aft Deck Bench
items.text: With optional Port & Starboard Bench Seats, and Activity Platforms. Standard 3+4 Sports Seats, Bulwark Seats. Gullwing Door Cushions and U-Sofa with Sunbed Cushion infill in the bow.

items.title: Wet Bar
items.text: With optional Port Fenderbox Bench Seat, Activity Platforms. Driver’s Sofa, Aft Sofa, and Bulwark Seats in Cockpit, U-Sofa with Table in the bow.

items.title: Cockpit U-Sofa
items.text: With Standard 3 Sports Seats. Double Fenderbox bench Seats. Gullwing Door Cushions & U-Sofa with table in the bow.

items.title: Cockpit U-Sofa with Sunbed Infill
items.text: With Sunbed Infill with Driver’s Sofa. Stbd. Fenderbox Bench Seat, Fenderbox Wet Bar, and Activity Platforms. Gullwing Door Cushions & U-Sofa with table in the bow.

items.title: Dinette & Sun Lounge
items.text: With Table. Optional Port & Starboard Bench Seats, and Activity Platforms. Standard 3+4 Sports Seats, Bulwark Seats. U-Sofa with Sunbed Cushion infill in the bow.

items.title: Dinette & Sun Lounge
items.text: With Sunbed Cushion Infill. Optional Port & Starboard Bench Seats, and Activity Platforms. Standard 3+4 Sports Seats, Bulwark Seats. U-Sofa with Sunbed Cushion infill in the bow.

items.title: Aft Cabin
items.text: With Stbd. Fenderbox Bench Seat, and Activity Platforms. Driver’s Sofa and Aft Sofa in the cockpit, with Bulwark Seats. Gullwing Door Cushions and Sun lounge in the bow.

items.caption: No two owners use their boat the same way. That's why the Axopar 38 features a modular aft deck concept, offering multiple layouts designed for socializing, exploring, watersports and overnight stays. Choose the configuration that fits your lifestyle and make every trip your own.

The unique Gullwing Doors seamlessly unite the fore deck and front cabin into one seamless space. Open the doors to blur the boundaries between indoors and outdoors, creating an airy, social environment unlike any conventional cabin layout.

A shaded escape, a private workspace, a cozy lounge or a place to spend the night. The modular front cabin adapts to the way you use your boat, offering a comfortable and protected environment while staying connected to the outdoors through Axopar's signature Gullwing Doors.

The Axopar 38 is designed around how people actually enjoy life on the water. From paddleboarding and e-foiling to swimming, entertaining guests, relaxing at anchor or spending the night onboard, every space is created to support an active and enjoyable boating lifestyle. The boat becomes a gateway to experiences, not simply a way to reach them.

items.name: For Boaters Who Want Both
items.title: For boaters Who Want Both
items.text: The Axopar 38 Cross Top bridges the gap between open and enclosed boating. Its distinctive forward-tilting wraparound windshield shelters the helm from wind, spray and glare, while the open cockpit and aft deck preserve the freedom, social atmosphere and connection to the water that define an open boat. Whether you're setting off on an early-season adventure or enjoying a warm summer afternoon, the Cross Top adapts effortlessly to the moment.

items.name: Engineered Beyond Expectations
items.title: Engineered Beyond Expectations
items.text: Beneath the surface, the Axopar 38 Cross Top benefits from an overbuilt stringer system that maximizes structural rigidity while maintaining an efficient strength-to-weight ratio. Extensive noise-reduction engineering enhances onboard comfort, while thoughtful details throughout the boat reflect Axopar's commitment to purposeful innovation and long-term durability.

items.name: Distinctive Design
items.title: Distinctive Design
items.text: The Axopar 38 Cross Top has a strong, distinctive design identity, shaped by purpose rather than decoration. Every line reflects its capability, giving the boat a confident and composed presence on the water. This clear, functional design language reinforces its position within the adventure boat category. It looks ready to perform because it is. A design that communicates strength, versatility, and intent from every angle.

items.name: Modular Throughout
items.title: Modular Throughout
items.text:
The Axopar 38 Cross Top is designed as a modular platform from bow to stern. Every area of the boat is developed with flexibility in mind, allowing it to adapt to different activities, preferences, and ways of spending time on the water. From the social bow layout to the configurable cockpit and versatile aft deck, each space works independently while remaining part of a cohesive whole. The boat can shift naturally from active use to relaxed moments without disruption.

The result is a more personal boating experience, where the layout supports how you use the boat rather than defining it. A platform that evolves with the day and with the people on board.

items.name: Proven Performance Platform
items.title: Proven Performance Platform
items.text: The Axopar 38 Cross Top offers a new, more social way to experience open boating while staying firmly rooted in the proven Axopar 38 platform. The hull delivers confident handling, high efficiency, and predictable control in a wide range of conditions. This means the open, social layout comes without compromise. Everyone stays connected in a single shared space while the drive remains precise, stable, and easy to manage. It is performance you trust, combined with a boating experience designed to be enjoyed together.

items.name: Effortless Ownership
items.title: Effortless Ownership
items.text: This platform is designed for efficiency and ease of use. Optimized fuel consumption, practical durability, and easy maintenance make the Axopar 38 Cross Top as straightforward to own as it is to drive. Every solution has a purpose. Unnecessary complexity is avoided in favor of what truly improves the experience, resulting in a boat that feels simple, intuitive, and ready to be used again and again.

items.name: Bench Seats
items.title: Bench Seats
items.text: A fenderbox can be more than just storage. Choose the optional Fenderbox Bench Seats with storage to transform it into a comfortable place to unwind. They add extra seating and create a natural spot for socializing, helping you make the most of every moment on the water.

items.name: Fenderbox Wetbar
items.title: Fenderbox Wetbar
items.text: The very popular Wet Bar in Fenderbox offers a convenient outdoor galley with a sink, faucet, and refrigerator, all integrated into the fender storage compartment, ideal for entertaining and enhancing usability.

items.name: Activity Platforms
items.title: Activity Platforms
items.text: The foldable Activity Platforms expand the aft deck into a larger, more versatile space that adapts to whatever the day brings. When opened, they create a wider area for watersports, swimming, and social gatherings, giving everyone more room to move comfortably around the stern. Designed to enhance both functionality and freedom of movement, the platforms add real usability to the aft deck and elevate the overall experience onboard.

items.name: Enclosed Toilet
items.title: Enclosed Toilet
items.text: The enclosed toilet in the front cabin adds everyday practicality and comfort for longer days on the water. The compartment offers generous standing height and a clean, modern design that integrates naturally into the cabin layout. Optional warm water and shower capability further expands onboard usability, making the space suitable for quick freshen‑ups.

items.name: Driver's Sofa Upgrade
items.title: Driver's Sofa Upgrade
items.text: The optional Driver’s Sofa Upgrade introduces a wide, supportive seating arrangement for the helm area. A reversible backrest and flip‑up bolsters let the driver easily switch between relaxed cruising and an active driving stance. The design improves long‑distance comfort while maintaining excellent ergonomics and visibility. It improves overall cockpit usability, giving the driver and co‑driver more space and a more comfortable seating experience on every trip.

items.name: U-Sofa in Bow
items.title: U-Sofa in Bow
items.text: The U‑sofa package transforms the bow into a true social zone. The wraparound seating creates an inviting space for conversations, meals, and relaxed cruising, while the central table supports dining and entertainment. The layout can also convert into a full sunbed, giving the bow multiple functions for different situations. With its open feel and multiple configuration options, the bow becomes one of the most versatile and enjoyable spaces onboard.

items.name: Gullwing Doors
items.title: Gullwing Doors
items.text: The Axopar 38 Front Cabin challenges conventional boat design. Thanks to the signature Gullwing Doors, the space is flooded with natural light and fresh air, creating an environment that feels open, connected and inviting. Instead of retreating below deck, you're still part of everything happening onboard.

items.name: Bulwark Seats
items.title: Bulwark Seats
items.text: Additional optional seating along the port and/or starboard bulwarks, together with the adaptable helm seating, supports both ease of movement and interaction, making it simple for people to gather around the driving area

items.name: Galley Module
items.title: Galley Module
items.text: The Galley Module adds practical convenience to the front cabin with dedicated space for a fridge and coffee machine. With an optional drawer fridge and cooktop, it supports quick meals and refreshments without taking up valuable cabin space. Its clean, efficient layout keeps everyday essentials within easy reach, enhancing comfort on longer days afloat.

items.title: BRABUS Line
modal_text:
BRABUS Line steering wheel in dark grey suede finish and BRABUS logo.

BRABUS Line passenger hatch grabrail in dark grey suede finish w. BRABUS signature.

BRABUS Line cleats in black with double B© signature.

Axopar 3D signature logo on both sides of hull in black finish.

BRABUS signature next to the Axopar logo on both sides of hull in black finish.

Heavy-duty rub rail on hull and swim platforms with endcaps in black finish.

Light mast in black finish.

Roof racks in black finish (if option chosen).

Engine frame in black finish (if option chosen).

items.title: The Mediterrana Edition
modal_text:
Designed for those who enjoy lounging, socializing, or cruising in the sun, the Mediterrana Edition enhances onboard comfort and sophistication without compromising functionality. Luxurious features include thicker, plush, more refined cushions in a sophisticated beige tone. The upholstery’s structured texture and patterns not only exude style but also keep lounging areas cool and comfortable, even on the sunniest days.

Elegant bamboo trays and cup holders, along with warm-toned interior finishes, create an inviting, cozy atmosphere. Beige fabric wall panels and bamboo technical panels further enhance the sophisticated look and feel of the lounging areas.

items.title: BRABUS Performance Line
modal_text: Experience the ultimate expression of power, style, and exclusivity with the BRABUS Performance Line. Designed for boaters who seek more from every journey, this upgrade combines the impressive performance of twin Mercury V10 425 hp engines with signature BRABUS styling details for an unmistakable presence on the water. The result is faster acceleration, greater responsiveness, and a more engaging driving experience, complemented by exclusive design elements that set your boat apart.

items.title: BRABUS Line Color Edition
modal_text: For style-conscious customers looking to make their Axopar 38 truly stand out, the Brabus Line Color Edition introduces four striking hull colors: the vibrant, playful Miami Blue; the more subtle, sophisticated Platinum Grey. The fresh, contemporary Glacier Blue; and the timeless, elegant Pearl White.
